text:
The dental clinic miscalculated the charges on two separate occasions.

- The first time, I went for fillings. Initially, they said it would only be a few teeth, but the actual work cost tens of thousands of baht without a detailed breakdown of the costs. Perhaps they thought they could charge whatever they wanted because I'm an elderly patient.

- The second time, they overcharged me for two extra dentures. I had to count them myself when I got home before I could question it and get a refund.

The clinic should have been more attentive and thorough in their billing.
